items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: Yeah, Clarence. I know his brother, Percy.

ctx.x: I never have met him, I don't think.
Yeah, Clarence. I know his brother, Percy. He's a little better fella.
I know Percy, the one that played the bass, but he's awful young. I doubt if you knew him. What did you know him?
